title: Imperfect and Pluperfect Subjunctive
summary: Use forms like se eu fosse and se eu tivesse feito for hypothetical and past unreal situations.

sections.heading: Imperfect subjunctive
sections.body:
The **imperfeito do subjuntivo** appears after expressions of desire, doubt, emotion, and conditions referring to the past or hypothetical present. It is built from the third-person plural preterite stem: fizeram → fizesse, foram → fosse.

| Subject | falar | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| se eu | **falasse** | **comesse** | **abrisse** |
| se você/ele/ela | **falasse** | **comesse** | **abrisse** |
| se nós | **falássemos** | **comêssemos** | **abríssemos** |
| se vocês/eles/elas | **falassem** | **comessem** | **abrissem** |

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse tempo, viajaria mais.
examples.en: If I had time, I would travel more.

examples.pt: Era importante que todos soubessem a verdade.
examples.en: It was important that everyone know the truth.

sections.heading: Common forms
sections.body:
Essential irregulars follow preterite-based stems.

| Subject | ser/ir | ter | fazer | poder | querer | vir |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| se eu | **fosse** | **tivesse** | **fizesse** | **pudesse** | **quisesse** | **viesse** |
| se você/ele/ela | **fosse** | **tivesse** | **fizesse** | **pudesse** | **quisesse** | **viesse** |
| se nós | **fôssemos** | **tivéssemos** | **fizéssemos** | **pudéssemos** | **quiséssemos** | **viéssemos** |
| se vocês/eles/elas | **fossem** | **tivessem** | **fizessem** | **pudessem** | **quisessem** | **viessem** |

examples.pt: Se ela falasse comigo, eu explicaria.
examples.en: If she talked to me, I would explain.
If we could, we would help.

examples.pt: Queria que eles fossem mais pacientes.
examples.en: I wanted them to be more patient.

sections.heading: Pluperfect subjunctive
sections.body:
Use **tivesse + past participle** for actions that would have happened before another past or hypothetical action. The participle is invariable.

| Subject | fazer | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| se eu | **tivesse feito** | **tivesse comido** | **tivesse aberto** |
| se você/ele/ela | **tivesse feito** | **tivesse comido** | **tivesse aberto** |
| se nós | **tivéssemos feito** | **tivéssemos comido** | **tivéssemos aberto** |
| se vocês/eles/elas | **tivessem feito** | **tivessem comido** | **tivessem aberto** |

examples.pt: Se eu tivesse sabido, teria ligado.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have called.

examples.pt: Ela agiu como se nada tivesse acontecido.
examples.en: She acted as if nothing had happened.

examples.pt: Gostaria que vocês tivessem avisado antes.
examples.en: I wish you had warned me earlier.

keyPoints: Imperfect subjunctive handles hypothetical or past-dependent uncertainty.
It often pairs with the conditional: se eu tivesse, eu faria.
The participle is invariable in tivesse feito.
